Also includes the two dedicated marker-owned staff registrations/service principals, business/floor roles and access_as_user, assignment-required access, ONLY the verified current deployment operator's Manager/API and native-client assignments, and operator-specific scenario-API delegated consent where current tenant capability permits. No runtime preview yet: actual generated outputs/digest/versions do not exist. Directory capability and staff login are untested; subscription Owner is not directory permission. The former environment's 0/500 quota is historical; the new environment must actually cover 28 rollout vCPU before apps. Shared estimate USD 745-1150/month, typical full 900-1650/month; max/rollout app compute alone 1103.76/2207.52 per month if sustained, plus services/usage/taxes; not a cap. This is a NEW grant, not reuse/expansion of the stopped foundation consent. Execute technical passes in one context through existing azd wiring and output receipts, with no routine foundation/image/app approval cards. Recheck identity/ownership/eligibility/preview freshness before writes; capture generated IDs automatically. Stop for actual denial/failure, new permission, materially changed scope/cost or destructive preview. Excludes Graph application permissions, tenant-wide/admin consent, installer self-elevation, new users/groups/credentials, provider registration, quota/SKU increases, other scopes, adoption/recovery/purge/deletion/cleanup, real payments, hack packages/events/publication and suitability approval. Real operator sign-in may require interaction; no authentication or acceptance success may be invented.

Local defects and independent previews are repaired.
